title: Could move sharply this week
target: A move of at least 10% more than the S&P 500 by the next close after the event.
directionPolicy: Direction unknown. There is not yet a validated model that can honestly call up versus down.
chanceMethod: Experimental empirical-Bayes estimate: next-session rises of at least 10% versus SPY after the company's latest 7–8 SEC earnings filings, shrunk toward the 31% pooled rate across these five companies with an eight-event prior weight.

signals.plainEnglish: more 10% moves among highly volatile shares
more after a 15%+ move in the prior month
more when recent trading volume was building
of giant-move events came from repeat movers

learnedSetup.warning: Research result, not a promise: these clues overlap, can point up or down, and are never multiplied into a fake probability. Corporate-action and point-in-time market-value filters are still incomplete.

candidates.name: Applied Optoelectronics
candidates.whyWatch: This is the most repeatedly explosive share in the five-name test: 55 benchmark-relative moves above 10% in the last 252 sessions. Earnings provide a dated trigger.
candidates.upsideCase: AI-network demand and the next-quarter outlook exceed what the market has priced in.
candidates.downsideCase: Growth or guidance fails to justify the expectations already attached to the AI story.

candidates.name: Astera Labs
candidates.whyWatch: The shares have produced 25 benchmark-relative 10% moves in the last 252 sessions and fell 23% over the latest measured month. Earnings can resolve whether that fall was excessive or justified.
candidates.upsideCase: Results beat the company's prior outlook and show that custom AI-connectivity products are ramping quickly.
candidates.downsideCase: Customer concentration or a slower product ramp weakens the growth story.

candidates.name: IonQ
candidates.whyWatch: IonQ has produced 17 benchmark-relative 10% moves in the last year. Its first quarter beat guidance and management raised its full-year revenue range, setting a demanding comparison.
candidates.upsideCase: Revenue beats the $65–68 million prior range and management raises the $260–270 million full-year outlook again.
candidates.downsideCase: Commercial progress or cash use disappoints against the very high growth expectations.

candidates.name: AppLovin
candidates.whyWatch: AppLovin has produced nine benchmark-relative 10% moves in the last 252 sessions and was down 25% over the latest measured month. The earnings update is a clear repricing point.
candidates.upsideCase: Advertising growth, margins and forward commentary show that the recent price fall went too far.
candidates.downsideCase: Growth or guidance slows while expectations remain demanding.

candidates.name: Advanced Micro Devices
candidates.whyWatch: AMD has produced seven benchmark-relative 10% moves in the last 252 sessions. Recent large AI partnerships make data-centre growth and guidance the decisive evidence.
candidates.upsideCase: Data-centre growth and the forward outlook confirm that new AI deployments are turning into revenue faster than expected.
candidates.downsideCase: Export limits, supply costs or guidance show that market expectations ran ahead of near-term earnings.
